project_type: FastAPI backend (Python 3.11) + React/Vite/TypeScript frontend, SQLite via SQLAlchemy, scikit-learn classifier, pure-Python risk engine
build_system: pip/requirements.txt for backend; npm/Vite for frontend. Backend entry point: uvicorn backend.main:app --reload. Frontend entry point: npm run dev (in web/). Scripts run from repo root.
test_framework: pytest for backend (backend/tests/). Run: pytest backend/tests/
build_command: No separate compile step for backend. Frontend: npm run build (in web/).
verification_instructions:
1. From repo root: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
2. python backend/seed.py
3. uvicorn backend.main:app --reload  (should start on :8000)
4. pytest backend/tests/  (all tests green)
5. python scripts/train_classifier.py  (saves backend/model/classifier.pkl)
6. python scripts/evaluate_classifier.py  (FP rate <= 10%)
7. In web/: npm install && npm run dev (renders on :5173)
environment_constraints: All paths in DB and file operations must be absolute. backend/engine/ must have ZERO FastAPI imports. Never store raw message text — SHA-256 hash only. Duress login response is IDENTICAL in shape AND timing to normal login (check BOTH hashes always with secrets.compare_digest).
contribution_requirements: shared/reason_codes.json and i18n/en.json must NOT be modified. All reason/advice codes in API responses must exist in shared/reason_codes.json. All i18n keys must match en.json keys (enforced by test_i18n_parity.py).
key_patterns: Pydantic v2 schemas throughout. SQLAlchemy 2.x ORM with UUID PKs. Bearer token auth (opaque UUID, not JWT). bcrypt PIN hashing. slowapi rate limiting on /login. Tier thresholds: SAFE=0-39, CAUTION=40-69, HIGH_RISK=70-100. Score blend: RULES_WEIGHT*rules_score + CLASSIFIER_WEIGHT*classifier_score. Reason codes from shared/reason_codes.json only.
directory_structure: backend/ — FastAPI app, models, schemas, routers, engine (pure Python, no FastAPI), decoy/, model/; web/ — React+Vite+TS frontend; shared/ — frozen reason_codes.json; i18n/ — lang JSON files; data/ — training/library JSON; scripts/ — train/evaluate classifier; docs/ — api_contract.md, README, demo_script
